channel.title: Court Cam
channel.desc: A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments; a 76-year-old man is tased and arrested for Disorderly Conduct and Resisting Arrest after refusing to follow the rules at a county hearing; a grieving family face their loved one's killer in court 14 years after he took her life; a defendant ordered to appear in person for his hearing angers the judge when he attends virtually from out of state; and more.
